summary: Legacy Authored authoring uses one-call batches up to 3 slides, serial first then max 2, overload downgrades to serial, failed-only recovery.
invariants: Each Authored batch provider call contains 1-3 slide indexes and returns per-slide HTML wrappers.
A new job starts with one author batch; after a batch returns at least one accepted slide, max wave concurrency is 2.
500/503/timeout/provider overload marks the job permanently serial.
Successful slides are checkpointed and excluded from recovery; recovery batches may contain only failed slides.
Per-slide provider attempt ordinals are reserved before the batch call while the physical provider receipt uses one deck-level batch slot.
forbidden: Do not regenerate accepted/checkpointed slides during recovery.
Do not treat fixture/unit tests as product-path provider/Chromium/COM proof.
